Strategy: Pay +100 for an exact fit and +20 for the [28,42] sweet band, combining the strongest possible close with the best band found so far.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (100 if r - item == 0 else 0) + (20 if 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
